دَفًا inf. n. of دَفِىَ [q. v.]. (M.) A bending, or curving. (T, S.) You say, of a man, فِيهِ دَفًا In him is a bending, or curving: and this is said of Ed-Dejjál. (T.) [See also دَفَأٌ.] ―
-b2- Also, in a mountain-goat, The having very long horns, extending towards his ears. (S.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
